**Page:** VGC 2016 rules and formats revealed – https://bulbanews.bulbagarden.net/wiki/VGC_2016_rules_and_formats_revealed

- “Players can use Pokémon from the National Pokédex except **Mew**, **Celebi**, **Jirachi**, **Deoxys**, **Phione**, **Manaphy**, **Darkrai**, **Shaymin**, **Arceus**, **Victini**, **Keldeo**, **Meloetta**, **Genesect**, **Diancie** and **Hoopa**.”

- “*Wednesday, December 9, 2015*” (article publication date).

- **Entities banned (15)**: Mew, Celebi, Jirachi, Deoxys, Phione, Manaphy, Darkrai, Shaymin, Arceus, Victini, Keldeo, Meloetta, Genesect, Diancie, Hoopa.
